valid.name: adapters layer resolves the token - this is the design

enum TransportMode { Cli = 'cli', Mcp = 'mcp' }
function create(transport: TransportMode): string { switch (transport) { case TransportMode.Mcp: return 'mcp'; default: return 'cli'; } }
